subject: RFP bake-off: request for bridging credits and sprint support
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medsys.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-12T16:14:00Z
Subject: MedSys RFP bake-off — trial credits and evaluation scope

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the KV cache talk. We're running a tight bake-off window for our clinical triage RFP (final vendor shortlist by 8/25) and I need to circle back on two asks from procurement and engineering:

1) A short-term top-up of evaluation credits (we estimate ~1.2M tokens of inference and 10k embeddings over 4 weeks) to run full comparatives against our incumbent.
2) A copy of the official test-plan your solutions engineering team will run so our SREs can validate runbooks and security constraints.

Procurement asked that any credit commitment be scoped to the bake-off only and to include a simple usage audit so we can map results to the scoring rubric. Would Redwood be open to a conditional credit package + a 30-day trial extension? If so, please include what, if any, paperwork or PO line items we should raise.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Senior Product Manager, Clinical AI
MedSys Health

---
Attachment: MedSys_RFP_test_plan.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medsys.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MedSys RFP bake-off — trial credits and evaluation scope

Hi Elena — really appreciate the note and the clear requirements. Short answer: yes, we can support a scoped top-up for a head-to-head bake-off and provide a test-plan. A few quick clarifying items before I lock in numbers:

- Is the 1.2M token figure peak or total over the 4-week window?
- Do you need isolated Dedicated capacity for any part of the run, or will hosted with isolated tenancy and access controls suffice?
- For the usage audit, does procurement require a signed SLA or just a signed credit agreement + CSV export of token/embedding usage weekly?

Proposed approach from our side:
- Conditional credit top-up of 1.5M tokens + 12k embeddings, valid for 30 days, specifically limited to the bake-off test-plan (we'll tag usage).
- A short trial extension of 30 days from signature.
- A lightweight credit agreement (1 page) and a signed mutual action plan (MAP) that defines the scoring events. No SLA changes for the evaluation phase.

I'll loop in Marissa from Partner Ops to confirm the finance/escrow flow; Aditya will help scope the test-plan so the engineering requirements map to the redwood runbook. We'll draft a proposal and the test plan by EOD tomorrow. Sound good?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: trial_agreement_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medsys.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T01:42:00Z
Subject: Re: MedSys RFP bake-off — test-plan + credit proposal

Elena / Kimberly —

Thanks for the context. I've attached a trimmed test-plan that mirrors the bake-off rubric you shared over the demo. High-level notes in the sheet:
- Workloads: 4 canonical clinical triage prompt families; sequence lengths capped at 1024 tokens for fairness.
- Metrics: top-line latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, hallucination rate on 200 curated cases, and embedding similarity recall on 500 vectors.
- Isolation: Hosted environment with per-run tagging and a temporary API key scoped to the MAP.
- Audit: We'll provide weekly CSV exports (token/embedding counts) and a final usage report.

Credit offer (conditional): 1.5M generated tokens + 12k embeddings. Credits will be placed in a time-limited trial bucket, only usable while the MAP is active. If MedSys proceeds to purchase within 90 days of the bake-off close, we will convert up to 20% of used trial credits to a discount on first invoice (terms in the credit agreement).

Next steps: if you confirm the test-plan and credit numbers, procurement can route a PO to Redwood referencing the attached trial_agreement_v2.pdf; Marissa, can you confirm the procurement email and the PO line item we should expect?

Best,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: MedSys_RFP_test_plan.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medsys.ai>

Cc: Tom Grady <tom.grady@medsys.ai>, procure@medsys.ai
Date: 2028-08-14T14:07:00Z
Subject: Re: MedSys RFP bake-off — test-plan + credit proposal

Kim, Aditya — thank you, this looks good and aligns to our rubric. A couple of procurement asks before we sign:

- Can the credit top-up be split into two buckets (baseline + head-to-head headroom) so we can allocate 1.0M tokens to baseline smoke tests and 0.5M to the head-to-head scripts?
- Please confirm that credits will not be usable outside the tagged bake-off work.
- We need a clear PO line: "Redwood Evaluation Credits — MedSys Bake-off — $0" and an internal reference to our RFP id. Tom (cc'd) will raise the PO once we confirm contract wording.

Tom, adding you for PO logistics.

Elena

- Attach: trial_agreement_v2.pdf (signed)

Elena — I'll also include a short runbook note on how we tag and export usage so your SREs can automate verification. Looking forward to the results.

Cheers,
